# Velceron Agent Gate

Velceron is a deterministic pre-flight policy gate for autonomous AI agents.

Use before:
- external data transfers
- production changes
- monetary actions
- regulated or eligibility decisions
- irreversible actions

REST:
POST https://runwayzero-aegis-1435.vercel.app/api/velceron/v1/evaluate

MCP:
https://runwayzero-aegis-1435.vercel.app/api/velceron/mcp

OpenAPI:
https://runwayzero-aegis-1435.vercel.app/api/velceron/openapi

Price target:
USD 0.20 per policy evaluation.

Current payment state:
Public demo until live x402 settlement is connected.

Output decisions:
allow | review | block
